text:
Priya (People Ops): quick Q — Lina (engineer) turned 50 on 2024-06-01 and elected 401(k) catch-up when she enrolled. Payroll appears to have applied catch-up to all prior pay periods this year which pushed her YTD deferrals over what she intended. Can payroll confirm what was applied and options to correct?

Sam (Payroll): looking now. Do we have which paycheck dates show the catch-up code? Lina, did you see a separate line `401K CATCHUP` on any paystub?

Lina: yep saw `401K CATCHUP` on 6/14 and also on 3/15 (but I wasn't eligible then). I only clicked the enrollment form on 5/20.

Sam (Payroll): ok that's a vendor mapping issue — our payroll vendor backfilled the catch-up to earlier pay periods because of the effective date on the election record. I can run a manual reversal for the erroneous entries. Two questions: 1) do we reverse via payroll refunds or via plan recordkeeper return-of-excess? 2) need plan vendor name & contact.

Priya (People Ops): plan vendor is Empower (recordkeeper). Policy-wise we generally ask recordkeeper to accept a return-of-excess contribution to avoid taxable distribution for the employee if possible. Ben, any tax/finance guidance?

Ben (Finance): yes — for excess catch-up contributions we prefer returning the excess to employee (non-taxable if handled as a corrective distribution by the plan) or recharacterized by the plan. If plan can't accept, employee may need distribution and 1099-R. Sam — coordinate with Empower first. If they accept, we run payroll reversals that map to the plan adjustment code.

Sam (Payroll): noted. I'll open a ticket with Empower and also prep a payroll correction batch. Sample command we'll run on our side: ```payroll-cli corrections create --type "401k-catchup-reversal" --emp "lina" --orig-paydates "2024-03-15,2024-06-14" --amounts "150.00,200.00" --note "return excess catch-up pending recordkeeper confirmation"```

Priya (People Ops): thanks. Lina — can you confirm you authorize payroll to process refunds to your net pay if Empower asks for the amount returned via payroll? Also please DM me the paystub screenshots (no SSNs) so Sam has exact amounts.

Lina: authorized. Uploaded screenshots to the PTO thread and DM'd Priya.

gusto-bot: Ticket #4521 created with Empower (esc to payroll-team). Estimated response 2 business days. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam (Payroll): will wait for Empower confirmation. If Empower accepts return-of-excess, I will: 1) create the plan adjustment (work with Ben for GL mapping), 2) run payroll corrections to remove the incorrect catch-up deferrals, 3) issue a net refund if needed. I'll post updates here when Empower replies.

Priya (People Ops): perfect — thanks everyone. We should also add a quick checklist to the new-hire enrollment SOP so catch-up elections don't backfill. Can someone (Sam or Ben) add a note?

Ben (Finance): I'll add a line to the SOP and include the vendor mapping step so elections get the right effective date.

Sam (Payroll): added to SOP draft and linked in #docs-payroll. Will follow up once Empower responds. :white_check_mark:
